The comparison of the four vendor quotations for 50 business laptops (RFQ‑2026‑014) is as follows:

| Vendor | Total Delivered Price (USD) | Delivery Lead Time |
|--------|-----------------------------|--------------------|
| Nimbus Tech Supply | **36,700.00** | 7 business days |
| Acme Computing Ltd | 37,550.00 | 14 business days |
| BrightPath Systems | **35,750.00** | 21 calendar days |
| Orbital IT Partners | 36,480.00 | 10 business days |

**Best price:** BrightPath Systems  
**Fastest delivery:** Nimbus Tech Supply

additional_kwargs.reasoning_content:
We have vendor quotations: Nimbus, Acme, BrightPath, Orbital. Need lowest total delivered price and fastest delivery. Let's parse each.

Nimbus: total delivered price 36,700.00. Delivery lead time 7 business days.

Acme: total delivered price 37,550.00. Delivery lead time 14 business days.

BrightPath: total delivered price 35,750.00. Delivery lead time 21 calendar days. Note: 21 calendar days vs business days. But we compare fastest delivery. Need to interpret. Usually business days vs calendar days. But we can treat as 21 days. So Nimbus 7 business days is fastest.

Orbital: total delivered price 36,480.00. Delivery lead time 10 business days.

Thus lowest price: BrightPath 35,750.00. Fastest delivery: Nimbus 7 business days.

We should double-check if any other vendor? No.

Thus answer.
